::: {.wx-lead} Evolutionary biologist working across phylogenetics, biogeography and conservation — from fieldwork on the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau to global-scale analyses of tropical plants. :::
  • 2026 — present Postdoctoral researcher Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • 2024 — 2026 Senior postdoctoral researcher Tropical Biodiversity Evolution group (DYNADIV), DIADE — IRD / Université de Montpellier / CIRAD, Montpellier, France
  • 2022 — 2024 Assistant researcher Laboratory of Herpetological Diversity and Evolution, Kunming Institute of Zoology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China
## Education
  • 2016 — 2022 PhD, Zoology Kunming Institute of Zoology, Chinese Academy of Sciences (GPA 3.7/4.0)
  • 2012 — 2016 BSc, Biotechnology Southern Medical University, China
## Research interests Macroevolution, macroecology and conservation; diversity patterns and their responses to climate change; phylogenetic and functional diversity; the biogeography of mountains and tropical rainforests; reproducible large-scale biodiversity analysis. ## Bibliometrics Publications in *Science*, *PNAS*, *Current Biology*, *National Science Review*, *Proceedings of the Royal Society B*, *Conservation Biology* and *Biological Conservation*, including one **ESI Highly Cited Paper** (Web of Science). See the [Publications](publications.qmd) page. ## Plenary and keynote presentations
  • July 2024 XX International Botanical Congress Functional trait, diversity patterns and conservation of Annonaceae: a representative of tropical rain forests
  • August 2021 2nd AsiaEvo Conference Reptiles and amphibians record the complex history of the Himalaya
  • August 2019 24th Annual Meeting, China Zoological Society Genome-wide data unveil the true landscape of biodiversity masked by cryptic species: Asian horned toads (Megophryidae) in southeast China
